definition: [ גְּנָזִים ] noun [masculine] plural 1. chests (?); 2. treasury — only plural construct גִּנְזֵי ; — 1. perhaps chests of variegated cloth בְּרֹמִים ׳ ג Ezek 27:24 so Thes AV RV ; Sm Co and others cloths, carpets , Ew Taschen . 2. treasury (Late Hebrew גֶּנֶז , Aramaic גִּנְזָא , גְּנִיז , Biblical Aramaic construct plural גִּנְזֵי ; Persian loan-word from treasure ? compare Vullers ii.1032 Lag Ges.Abh.27 ); גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ Esth 3:9 ; Esth 4:7 .

[גְּנָזִים] noun [masculine] plural

1. chests (?);
2. treasury — only plural constructגִּנְזֵי; —
1. perhaps chests of variegated cloth בְּרֹמִים ׳ג Ezek 27:24 so Thes AV RV; Sm Co and others cloths, carpets, Ew Taschen.
2. treasury (Late Hebrew גֶּנֶז, Aramaic גִּנְזָא, גְּנִיז, Biblical Aramaic construct plural גִּנְזֵי; Persian loan-word from treasure? compare Vullersii.1032 LagGes.Abh.27); גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ Esth 3:9; Esth 4:7.
